intro: Keeping your keys safe has never been this simple. The NX Key Storage Locker offers robust security thanks to a customisable password, solid steel shooting bolts and emergency entry options. Whether at home, in the office, or managing multiple properties, this key cabinet keeps everything organised and safe, giving you peace of mind.

features.title: Digital Locking Mechanism
features.text: A highly secure digital lock that operates with customizable 4 to 8 digit user passwords, featuring a 6-digit master password for emergency access to the safe.

features.title: Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: The robust steel shooting bolts deliver secure multi-point reinforcement against forced entry, ensuring dependable and elevated security performance.

features.title: 27 Key Holder Slots
features.text: The locker features 27 key holder slots, providing secure and systematic storage for multiple keys. Each slot is clearly designated to ensure organized access and efficient key management.

features.title: Autolock Keypad Freeze Function
features.text: Automatic sensor freeze function that keeps your valuables safe by preventing unauthorised access after 4 consecutive wrong password entries

features.title: Emergency Mechanical Override & Auxiliary Battery Backup
features.text: In the event of a low-battery condition, the lock is equipped with an emergency mechanical override key to ensure uninterrupted access. Additionally, the auxiliary battery backup enables temporary power support during emergencies, allowing immediate access and ensuring reliable operation at all times.

features.title: Mounting & Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection,this feature allows you to securely mount or grout the safe to walls, floors, or shelves using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
